title: Arkret Signal Peer Relay Request
description: Bounded single-hop peer relay request for encrypted SignalEnvelope values. The request is short-lived, best-effort, non-idempotent, and never creates durable Event, Seal, frontier, receipt, or delivery state.

realm_id.description: The only Realm represented by this request. Every signals[].realm_id and signals[].scope_ref.realm_id MUST equal this value.

signals.description: Original producer-signed encrypted envelopes. The source and destination services MUST NOT alter, re-sign, decrypt, or re-encrypt an item.
